task:
Wire the souin fork (~/ergo/souin) into the Caddy build and document the two patched upstream bugs. State: the fork is cloned at ~/ergo/souin @v1.7.7 with TWO UNCOMMITTED patches in pkg/middleware/middleware.go (marked with '// erfi.io patch:' comments): (A) born-stale fix - Store() no longer subtracts full upstream latency from fresh TTL, it now subtracts only the response's apparent age from its Date header (upstream line ~314 did `ma = ma - time.Since(context.Now)`); (B) revalidation-doubling fix - added the missing `_, _ = customWriter.Send(); return err` after a successful Revalidate in the stale-if-error block (~line 937), which previously FELL THROUGH to the bottom Upstream() call, causing a second origin fetch and a doubled-body store that corrupted entries (verified: hits served 'static-body-v1static-body-v1', Content-Length 28). The local cache suite (test/cache, `make test-cache`) is 65/65 green on the UNPATCHED image; test 17 is dual-mode: it passes with 'KNOWN BUG reproduced' on upstream souin and with 'souin fork patch active' once the patched binary is in the image.

Do, in order:
1. Commit the patch in ~/ergo/souin: plain git commit (no author overrides, NO AI attribution/trailers), conventional-commit message like `fix(middleware): stop born-stale stores and revalidation double-store`.
2. Publish the fork: `cd ~/ergo/souin && gh repo fork --remote=false` or `gh repo create erfianugrah/souin --public --source . --push` (fork of a public repo is fine to be public). Push the commit.
3. Dockerfile (~/ergo/caddy-compose/Dockerfile): add to the xcaddy manifest `--with github.com/darkweak/souin=github.com/erfianugrah/souin@<commit-sha>` (xcaddy replace syntax) with a comment in the house style (see the pinning-discipline comment block above the RUN) explaining the fork carries the two erfi.io patches. Follow AGENTS.md Caddy-module pin discipline.
4. Rebuild: `make build-caddy`, then `rm -f test/cache/.work/caddy` so the suite re-extracts the binary from the fresh image.
5. Verify `make test-cache` is green AND its output contains 'souin fork patch active' (test 17's fixed branch). Also expect: test 14 /slow post-warm-up hit still passes (bug A fix), no doubled bodies (bug B fix).
6. Docs: add two quirks to test/cache/README.md in the exact style of the existing numbered quirks ('### 6. Slow origins are born stale (fixed in the erfi.io souin fork)' and '### 7. Revalidation doubles the stored body (fixed in the erfi.io souin fork)') with the source citations already present in run-tests.sh test 14/17 comments, and the empirical evidence (nuts dump: doubled Date/Via, 28-byte body; debug log: 'Store the response ... with duration -669.340244ms'). Add a one-line bullet each to the AGENTS.md 'Edge HTTP cache' behavioral-quirks list. Fix the test 17 comment to say the fix is LANDED (keep the dual-mode assertion as the regression gate).
7. Do NOT touch version tags, compose files, or deploy. Do NOT commit in caddy-compose - leave the working tree dirty.

Sensors must all pass; the cache-suite sensor runs the full suite so keep it green throughout.
